name: Eastern Kentucky University
academic_ranking: Public university in Richmond, KY. Fall 2024 enrollment ~15,673 total (~13,448 undergraduate). Ranked #329 (tie) nationally by U.S. News & World Report; accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools. Branch campuses in Corbin, Hazard, and Manchester plus 40+ online degree options.
financial_aid: About 41% of EKU students receive an income-based federal Pell grant (classified as low-income). Athletic scholarships for softball are governed by NCAA D1 limits (up to 12 equivalency scholarships). Specific 2026 tuition figure not confirmed from a live source; institutional and need-based aid available via eku.edu financial aid office.
facilities_notes: Softball plays home games at Gertrude Hood Field. Program also has a dedicated indoor Softball Hitting Facility (per ekusports.com facilities listing).
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the ASUN Conference. EKU joined the ASUN in 2021-22. Coaching staff led by head coach Jane Worthington.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured from ekusports.com softball pages, verified via the athletics staff directory (checked 2026-07). No public phone numbers or individual coach Twitter/X handles listed; team account @eku_softball appears on the coaches page. Tuition set to null because no reliable live figure could be confirmed without guessing.
